# Upcoming Commissioner Colleges

**Date**| **Council and City**| **Information**  
---|---|---  
December 7, 2024| Western Massachusetts Council  
Westfield, MA| **Location:** Pathfinder Regional Vocational Technical High
School, Palmer, MA**Time:** 8:00 AM – 5:15 PM**Cost:** $$45, registration
deadline is November 27Course Offerings:

  * Bachelors of Commissioner Science
  * Masters of Commissioner Science
  * Doctorate of Commissioner Science
  * Commissioner Continuing Education

For More Information and registration visit
<https://www.wmascouting.org/ccs>.Contact Matt Tassinari for additional
information at [mtass@mtass.com](mailto:mtass@mtass.com).  
January 11, 2025| Circle Ten Council  
Richardson, TX| **Location:** 10 Service Center, 904 Abrams Rd., Richardson,
TX 75081**Time:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (7:30 AM – 8:00 AM Check-in)**Cost:**
$20/person. A lunch may be purchased for an additional $10. No walk-in
registration and lunch cannot be purchased on the day of the event.Course
Offerings:

  * Commissioner Position-Specific Training
  * Bachelors of Commissioner Science
  * Masters of Commissioner Science
  * Doctorate of Commissioner Science
  * Commissioner Continuing Education

Registration at <https://scoutingevent.com/571-2025UofSSpring>.Contact Ann
Boudreaux for additional information at
[annbudo@gmail.com](mailto:annbudo@gmail.com).  
February 1, 2025| Middle Tennessee Council  
Lebanon, TN| **Location:** Cumberland University, Labry Hall, 1 Cumberland
Square, Lebanon, Tennessee 37087**Time:** 7:45 AM – 4:30 PM**Cost:** $35
advance registration; $45 walk-on registrationOn February 1, 2025 the Middle
Tennessee Council will be hosting a combined College of Commissioner Science
from six different councils. Commissioners will have the opportunity to
fellowship and learn with commissioners from the Cherokee Council, Chickasaw
Council, Great Smoky Mountain Council, Middle Tennessee Council, Natchez Trace
Council, and West Tennessee Council.Commissioner service strives to help each
unit be the best it can be and our commissioners deserve the very best tools
to help them succeed in the ever-changing world of Scouting. The College of
Commissioner Science takes commissioners beyond the basic training, further
developing critical leadership, coaching, and communication skills.The last
day to register is January 24 (There will be no late registrations – anyone
wishing to attend after registration closes will be coming as a walk-on).This
is an in person event and there will not be any virtual classes. So register
now and join us in person for some great fellowship, fun, and
learning.**Keynote Session Speaker:** Scott Sorrels, National Commissioner for
Scouting AmericaFor more information see the [event
flyer](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/11/CCS2025-flyerpdf.pdf) or
<https://scoutingevent.com/560-90553>.  
February 8, 2025| CST 8  
Fort Worth, TX| **Location:** Tarrant County College: Trinity River Campus,
300 Trinity Campus Circle, Fort Worth, TX 76102 (in-person); or Virtually at
your home.**Time:** 8:00am – 4:30pm**Cost:** In-Person: $30 until Jan 19th,
2024 (includes $5 early-bird discount); … $35 after Jan 19th (walk-ins: $35
based on class availability and box lunch); Virtual: $15**Course Offerings:**

  * Bachelors of Commissioner Science
  * Masters of Commissioner Science
  * Doctorate of Commissioner Science
  * Commissioner Continuing Education

We have virtual options for those not able to join in person. Enjoy lunch with
our guest speaker and all participants receive a commemorative pocket
patch.For more information and to register visit
<https://scoutingevent.com/480-91853> or contact Christopher Mahanna,
[mahanna.scouting@gmail.com](mailto:mahanna.scouting@gmail.com)  
February 22, 2025| Northern California Councils  
Greater San Francisco Bay Area, CA| **SAVE THE DATE!**  
****Registration for the 2025 Norcal College coming soon. Registration will be
available for all scouters, staff, and scouting professionals. Lunch is
